channel.title: Infra on wid's blog
channel.description: Recent content in Infra on wid's blog

item.title: Security Groups and NACLs
item.description: How Security Groups (stateful, per-instance) and NACLs (stateless, per-subnet) form different layers of defense in a VPC, plus the common pitfalls each surface.

item.title: Connecting VPCs to Other Networks — Peering, VPN, Transit, PrivateLink
item.description: Comparing the four mechanisms that connect a VPC to other VPCs, on-premises networks, and external services — Peering, Transit Gateway, Site-to-Site VPN, and PrivateLink — across topology and cost.

item.title: VPC Traffic Flow with Route Tables
item.description: How Route Tables decide traffic paths inside a VPC, the role of Internet Gateway and NAT Gateway as external exits, and the actual meaning of Public/Private Subnet.

item.title: VPC and the Isolation Model
item.description: How VPC simulates a private network boundary by combining IP CIDR, Subnet, and Tenancy. Includes vendor naming map across AWS / GCP / Azure / Alibaba.

item.title: Kubernetes Fundamentals
item.description: Container orchestration basics and what backend developers need to know: core objects, networking, scaling with HPA, and operational essentials.

item.title: Docker Container Fundamentals
item.description: Covers container concepts, the differences from VMs, Docker’s architecture, and the basics of Dockerfile and Docker Compose.

item.title: Kafka Fundamentals and KRaft Mode
item.description: Core Kafka concepts (topics, partitions, consumer groups, replication) and the background behind KRaft mode, which removes the ZooKeeper dependency.
